Issue Details
### Description Etymology App failed to launch with error that Header's referrer is missing when run against .NET 7.0. ### Reproduction Steps **Repro steps for the Problematic App:** This is 5.0 app, issue occurs when we run against .NET 7.0 1.Launch Etymology.Web.exe from Etymology. 2.Open Edge https://localhost:5001. **Minimal Repro steps:** 1.Create a new web project. 2.Create a settings.json. ``` { "IndexPagePaths": [ "/", "/index.htm" ] } ``` 3.Create Settings.cs. ``` public class Settings { public List IndexPagePaths { get; } = new(); } ``` 4.Input the following code in startup.cs. ``` public Startup() { IConfigurationBuilder configurationBuilder = new ConfigurationBuilder(); configurationBuilder.AddJsonFile(Path.Combine("settings.json"), optional: false, reloadOnChange: true); this.configuration = configurationBuilder.Build(); } public static IServiceCollection AddSettings(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration, out TSettings settings) where TSettings : class { settings = configuration.Get(); return services.AddSingleton(settings); } public void ConfigureServices(IServiceCollection services) { services.AddSettings(this.configuration, out Settings settings); if (settings.IndexPagePaths.Count == 0) { Console.WriteLine("Can't get IndexPagePaths!"); }; services.AddRazorPages(); } ``` 5.When use default sdk 5.0, settings.IndexPagePaths.Count == 2. When use sdk 7.0, settings.IndexPagePaths.Count == 0. ### Expected behavior Web page should load successfully. ### Actual behavior It shows an error: Header's referrer is missing. ### Regression? Yes Verify Scenarios: 1). Windows rs5 x64 + dotnet-sdk-7.0.100-alpha.1.21568.2: Fail 2). Windows rs5 x64 + dotnet-sdk-5.0.404-win-x64:Pass 3). Windows rs5 x64 + dotnet-sdk-6.0.101:Pass ### Known Workarounds It will work after changing ``` public List IndexPagePaths { get; } = new(); ``` to ```public List IndexPagePaths { get; set;} = new();``` ### Configuration **Application Name**: Etymology **OS**: Windows 10 RS5 **CPU:** X64 **.NET Build Number:** dotnet-sdk-7.0.100-alpha.1.21568.2 **App Github Repo link:** https://github.com/Dixin/Etymology **App, App Source and Minimal Repro Code checking at:** https://devdiv.visualstudio.com/DevDiv/_workitems/edit/1458234 ### Other information @dotnet-actwx-bot @dotnet/compat
Author: Junjun-zhao
Assignees: -
Labels: `untriaged`, `area-Extensions-Configuration`

I was able to repro this with a simple console app.  The first 7.0 build that repros is 7.0.0-alpha.1.21514.8 which corresponds to https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/60415 cc @safern @danielmpetrov

That change broke the scenario where an object has a read-only property with a mutable collection.

Here's a simple repro:
[config.zip](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/files/7825135/config.zip)
Interesting that we didn't have test coverage for that scenario. We should definitely fix this, I'm not longer on this area ownership, but shouldn't be a hard fix.
Reverting the regression for now.  I'll add the detail to the other issue to address this scenario in the fix.
